newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads three for drug smuggling, murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads three for drug smuggling, murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday beheaded two Pakistanis for smuggling heroin into the kingdom and one Saudi national for murder, the official media reported.

An Interior Ministry statement carried by the official Saudi Press Agency said the two Pakistani men were beheaded in the western city of Medina, raising to 23 the number of people executed on drugs charges since the beginning of May.
A separate statement carried by state-run television said the Saudi man had been found guilty of shooting dead another Saudi and was beheaded in the south-western province of Asir.
The three public beheadings by the sword raised to 67 the number of executions this year in the conservative Islamic kingdom.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug smugglers and other criminals. It executed a total of 68 people last year.
